title: Campus Attire Amounts for Hollis Middle School and Mesquite Ridge High School Ensembles — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Campus attire amount.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a campus attire amount is added to the concert attire package of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** by the campus on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year, the record Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions keeps: plus 5.00 for Hollis Middle School, plus 10.00 for Mesquite Ridge High School, and nothing otherwise.

- Hollis Middle School on the record: plus 5.00.
- Mesquite Ridge High School on the record: plus 10.00.
- Ridgecrest Middle School, Calloway Creek High School or any other campus on the record, or no record in status enrolled for the school year: nothing.

The campus that counts is the one on the enrollment record of the school year.
